sources.title: Aion2.gg Oct16 dataset: shared reward-counter table only; dungeon availability superseded by Oct21 patch

activities.name: Duty Missions
activities.instruction: Open Escape → Journal → Duty. Complete up to the five shared-server Duty missions you want. Check rewards before accepting; redraw costs Kina and becomes more expensive.

activities.name: Daily Dungeon
activities.instruction: Open Escape → Daily Dungeon and check the remaining shared entries. The reviewed base allowance is 14 entries per week per server, not two daily refills. Complete suitable available runs before Wednesday reset; confirm your actual remaining allowance in game.
rewardTags: Enhance Stones; amount depends on score

activities.name: Command scrolls: home region
activities.instruction: Visit the Command Merchant in your main city. Check the faction home-region Command scrolls: Altgard for Asmodians, Verteron for Elyos. Buy only the scrolls you plan to use; consume a scroll to start a Command quest. Quests can be completed later. The reviewed weekly shop allowance is 12 scroll purchases per server, not a cap on completed quests. Check the actual remaining shop allowance before buying.

activities.name: Command scrolls: Lower Abyss
activities.instruction: Visit your faction’s Lower Abyss Command Merchant and review Normal, Veteran, Elite and Special scrolls. Each tier has five weekly purchases per server: 20 across the four tiers. Buy only quests you can complete and check the PvP-area risk. These are shop allowances, not quest-completion limits.

activities.name: Ascension Trial
activities.instruction: Open Escape → Ascension Trial. Select a difficulty your current Gear Score and combat ability support, and use available entries before Wednesday reset. Entries are shared among the six Trial dungeons. The reviewed base allowance is 3 entries per character per week across those dungeons; confirm the actual remaining entries.

activities.name: Nightmare attempts
activities.instruction: Open Escape → Nightmare. Review the available attempts and use them on a suitable stage before the bank reaches its cap. Check clear-grade rewards. The reviewed bank adds 2 attempts per daily reset and stores up to 14; unused attempts carry over.
rewardTags: First-clear or achievement rewards when available

activities.name: Shugo Festival reward keys: server
activities.instruction: Open Main Menu → Shugo Festival. Join an hourly game during the three-minute entry window and review the reward cards. Use available reward keys before the shared bank caps; participation and reward claims are separate. The reviewed base server pool adds 3 keys per daily reset and stores up to 12; membership can alter it.

activities.name: Dimensional Invasion reward key
activities.instruction: Watch the :30 event notice and enter within its three-minute window. Review the reward selection and available keys before claiming. Use keys before their shared bank caps. The reviewed server pool adds 1 key per daily reset and stores up to 7.

activities.name: Nightmare shop: weekly goods
activities.instruction: Open the Nightmare Trade Shop and review weekly goods you can afford with Phantasmal Fragments. Soul Codex packs have five purchases per week and Soul Codex: Reset has three. Leave permanent/lifetime-limit goods out of a weekly counter.

activities.name: Subjugation
activities.instruction: Review available Subjugation entries and choose an eligible dungeon; the four dungeons share this allowance. The reviewed base allowance is 3 entries per character per week across all four; confirm the actual remaining entries.

activities.name: Conquest reward-claim pools
activities.instruction: Review the Conquest reward counter and your Odyle before claiming rewards. The current Global client reference models one character pool shared across all Conquest dungeons: 1 claim every 8 hours (3 per day), up to 21 stored. Claims recharge continuously, not at the daily reset; this daily checkmark only records your review, not a weekly entry limit. A normal claimed reward cube also costs 40 Odyle. Check the separate shared-server unclaimed-clear counter in game. Your actual available claims, energy and counter balances are unknown.

activities.name: Transcendence reward-claim pools
activities.instruction: Review Deus Research Base or Shattered Arkanis claim availability and choose a stage that supports your current plan. The current Global client reference models one character pool shared across all Transcendence dungeons: 1 claim every 12 hours (2 per day), up to 14 stored. Claims recharge continuously, not at the daily reset; this daily checkmark only records your review. A normal claimed reward cube also costs 40 Odyle. Check the separate shared-server unclaimed-clear counter in game. Your actual available claims, energy and counter balances are unknown.

limitations: Checkmarks are manual reports, not observed rewards, currencies or quest state.
Daily recharge checks do not reset or estimate a stored bank.
Server scope is private to the signed-in account on one region/server.
The 12 and 20 weekly Command counts refer to shop purchases, not quest-completion caps.
Do not infer membership, available entries, selected difficulty or reward affordability.

excluded.name: Shugo Festival reward keys: character
excluded.reason: A raw client ticket row does not prove an active separate character entitlement. The current Global reference retired the 4-per-day, cap-28 character-bank claim and lists the shared-server base pool only. Membership modifications remain manual; no extra character pool is inferred.
